content.title: Functional Materialization | Empty Hands to Utility and Terminal Callback
content.summary: Establish both hands as visibly empty before one attributable trigger assembles a single functional object in readable stages. Keep subject identity and hand ownership continuous, require immediate use, let one environmental variable accumulate in response, and end with the object still present beside one function-linked terminal change.

quick_start.input_format: clearly adult subject + empty-hands baseline + one trigger + staged single-object assembly + immediate functional proof + accumulating environmental response + persistent object and terminal callback
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult observatory technician in slate workwear shows both gloved hands empty on a dark mineral platform. One tap on a copper wrist clasp assembles a folding brass wind harp from amber magnetic plates. The technician turns its calibrated wheel as three black-sand rings rise in order; a narrow copper stripe settles on the same coat while the completed harp remains held.
required_anchors: Show both hands empty long enough to establish one unambiguous baseline.
Use one visible trigger and one staged assembly path for a single object.
Make the completed object perform its defining function immediately.
End with the object still present and one function-linked secondary state change.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish both hands as visibly empty before one attributable trigger assembles a single functional object in readable stages. Keep subject identity and hand ownership continuous, require immediate use, let one environmental variable accumulate in response, and end with the object still present beside one function-linked terminal change.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one adult subject, both visibly empty hands and one stable environment before any effect. Use exactly one attributable trigger to assemble one functional object in readable stages between the same hands; keep subject identity, hand ownership and geography continuous. Require immediate functional use, then let one environmental variable accumulate in response to that use. End with the object still present and one secondary state change visibly tied to the completed action. The reusable mechanism is empty-hand proof, staged materialization, functional payoff and terminal callback, not the source man, suit, guitar, electricity, roses, fog, petals, exact orbit, creator wording or model branding.

invariants.rule: Show both hands empty long enough to establish one unambiguous baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning with effects or a hidden hand turns appearance into an assumption.

invariants.rule: Use one visible trigger and one staged assembly path for a single object.
invariants.purpose: Gives object formation an attributable cause and readable continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant replacement or multiple unexplained objects becomes a generic transformation montage.

invariants.rule: Keep the same subject, hand ownership and environment continuous while the object forms.
invariants.purpose: Prevents identity or prop swapping from faking the mechanism.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut to another holder breaks causal ownership.

invariants.rule: Make the completed object perform its defining function immediately.
invariants.ablation_failure: A formed but unused prop is only spectacle.

invariants.rule: End with the object still present and one function-linked secondary state change.
invariants.purpose: Provides persistent proof and a terminal callback.
invariants.ablation_failure: Making the object vanish or adding an unrelated makeover abandons the causal chain.

slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult man, face, black-to-white business suit, poses and exact identity
the source black-and-white electric guitar, blue electrical assembly, hand choreography and playing gestures
the source foggy field of small white roses, swirling petals and exact environmental response
the source orbital timing, flower-density curve, suit recoloring and terminal composition
the source creator identity, model branding, watermark and exact prompt wording
